_about: Phase 1f Category A/B annotation for the wall-gate negatives, plus the observable confusion fields the brief's section 7 asks for. Additive: the shared fixture tests/fixtures/relationship_benchmark.json is NOT touched by this phase.
_blocker: The brief asked for >=25 negatives. Every one of the 11 moodboard renders and 8 reference photos was examined; the imagery supports 5. The accounting is in docs/benchmarks/phase_1f_report.md. No case was invented, and no ambiguous piece was annotated NEGATIVE to reach a count.
_ground_truth_rule: POSITIVE = the queried object itself physically contacts a wall. NEGATIVE = it does not. The presence of a wall somewhere behind the object is NOT part of the rule - it is recorded separately below, because whether the model is keying on it is the hypothesis under test.
_category_rule: A = genuinely open floor: no wall-backed mass immediately behind the object at similar depth; floor visible around it. B = free-standing but wall-backed context: a wall-backed object or surface sits immediately behind it and overlaps it in the image. Assigned by eye from the render; the observable fields are recorded so the assignment can be re-derived.
